paragraphs.text: Some time ago, an interesting discovery was made by archaeologists on the Aegean island of Kea.

paragraphs.text: An American team explored a temple which stands in an ancient city on the promontory of Ayia Irini. promontory (headland)

inlineAnnotations.label: promontory

inlineAnnotations.label: a long narrow area of high land that sticks out into the sea.

paragraphs.text: The city at one time must have been prosperous, for it enjoyed a high level of civilization.
paragraphs.translation: 这座古城肯定一度很繁荣，因为它曾享有高度的文明。

inlineAnnotations.label: at one time

inlineAnnotations.description: 本句中理解为：“享有”

paragraphs.text: Houses — often three storeys high — were built of stone. They had large rooms with beautifully decorated walls.

inlineAnnotations.description: 后置定语表从属关系，(墙属于房间并且墙壁装饰得很漂亮)

paragraphs.text: The city was even equipped with a drainage system, for a great many clay pipes were found beneath the narrow streets.
paragraphs.translation: 城里甚至还敷设了排水系统，因为在狭窄的街道底下发现了许许多多陶土制作的排水管道。

inlineAnnotations.description: 排水系统：指在特定的排水盆地中由溪流、河流和湖泊形成的模式。

inlineAnnotations.label: clay pipes
inlineAnnotations.description: 陶土做成的管道

inlineAnnotations.label: narrow streets
inlineAnnotations.description: 狭窄的街道
